ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left is a standard watch dial, with the numbers 1 to 12 arranged in the usual clock-face positions. On the right is a dark disk, with three round holes on the disk; judging from the positions of the holes in the figure, they correspond to the three hour positions 1, 5, and 7 on the clock face. Reasoning: When the disk rotates around its own center, the three holes rotate together as a whole, so the relative intervals between them remain unchanged. Treat the positions of the holes modulo 12 on the clock face. If the current hole pattern is rotated backward by one hour position as a whole, then 1 becomes 12, 5 becomes 4, and 7 becomes 6. Therefore the numbers that can be seen at the same time are 4, 6, and 12.

raw_record.question_text: A dark disc with three holes is placed on top of a dial of a watch (see diagram). Then the disc is rotated around its centre. Which numbers can be seen at the same time?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the watch dial has the usual 12 numbers, and the dark disc has three holes positioned over the clock locations that currently correspond to 1, 5, and 7. Treat the hour positions as numbers modulo 12. From the text, the whole disc is rotated about its centre, so every hole moves by the same number of hour-steps and the relative pattern is unchanged. Rotate the hole pattern by one hour-step backward: 1 becomes 12, 5 becomes 4, and 7 becomes 6. Therefore the numbers visible together can be 4, 6, and 12.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the three holes form a triangular pattern on the disc, with one hole near the 1 position, one near the 5 position, and one near the 7 position of a clock face. Instead of tracking an absolute rotation, compare the circular gaps between holes. In clockwise order the hole pattern has gaps 1 to 5 = 4 hour intervals, 5 to 7 = 2 intervals, and 7 back to 1 = 6 intervals. Look for the same spacing pattern on the dial: 12 to 4 is 4 intervals, 4 to 6 is 2 intervals, and 6 back to 12 is 6 intervals. Since the spacing pattern matches exactly, a rotation of the disc can place the holes over 12, 4, and 6 at the same time.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一个普通表盘，数字 1 到 12 按钟面顺序排列。右侧是一个深色圆盘，圆盘中心有一个小点，圆盘上有三个圆孔；从图中看，这三个孔形成三角形位置，分别大约在钟面上的 1 点、5 点和 7 点方向。

推理：不需要固定圆盘的绝对位置，只比较三个孔之间沿圆周的间隔。按顺时针看，孔的位置间隔为：从 1 到 5 相差 4 个小时刻度，从 5 到 7 相差 2 个小时刻度，从 7 回到 1 相差 6 个小时刻度。表盘上也要找同样的间隔模式：从 12 到 4 相差 4 个小时刻度，从 4 到 6 相差 2 个小时刻度，从 6 回到 12 相差 6 个小时刻度。因此圆盘旋转后，三个孔可以同时露出 12、4、6。
